content: Linux default UDP SO_RCVBUF is ~208KiB (net.core.rmem_default 212992); requests above rmem_max are silently capped. Kernel drops new datagrams when the buffer fills - visible as RcvbufErrors in netstat -su. Fix: conn.SetReadBuffer(n) with n in MB, dedicated read goroutine in a tight loop with reusable buffer, monitor RcvbufErrors. Red Hat tuning docs + Baeldung confirm. sup-kv burst of 1000 writes/s x ~60KiB DataReplication broadcasts can overflow a default buffer in milliseconds.
